body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews and worker reports of the V1 wave-2 pull requests (#82-#85). PR #83 (V1-0010): only the new fix: line tells the two cases apart; intent-scope-drift is likewise often a knock-on of an ocm-prepare refusal.
title: dogfood: `dogfood-report-drift` covers both a stale and an incomplete report
